answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 43911 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Islamic Names Question: Is the name "Hind" Arabic name and what does it mean? Is this the name of Prophet Mohammad’s (SAW) wife? Can I name my daughter "Hind"? Answer ID: 43911 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 348/348/M=1434) Hind is an Arabic word. It is spoken for the folk of camel that ranges from 100 to 200. هند اسم لجماعة من الإبل عددها من نحو مأة إلى مئتين (المعجم الوسيط) No holy wife was named as Hind. You may keep the name Hindah for your daughter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
